signature.name: Seam & Wait Honesty
signature.description: Whether the loop's 5s-to-0s wrap is invisible in position, opacity and velocity, never fakes completion, and leaves every random frame a dignified place to cut away when the network decides the wait is over.

bare-wire.signature_why: Scar starts and ends at opacity 0 and the heal disc is crema-on-crema, so the 1s wrap is invisible and nothing ever finishes; but a high-contrast dark ring every second gives a few stop-frames that look mid-impact.
bare-wire.loved: Six shapes, two easing curves, fills only, one container-sized component; the leanest and most disciplined build on the table, with a README that says what it did not verify.
bare-wire.docked: The 'inverse of a ripple' is in practice an expanding dark concentric ring every second, so at 120px it reads as a ripple/target pulse at an insistent 1Hz rather than a calm heal.

warm-hands.signature_why: Linear 360deg sweep plus a zero-slope sway at the wrap means no position or velocity seam (verified in code and frames), no finish beat ever, and any frame is a clean pose of a pour in progress; reduced motion holds a composed pose that breathes.
warm-hands.loved: One slow net turn per 5s with a wrist's speed variation: steady, never reverses, never resolves; the wait honestly reads as 'someone is pouring' whether it lasts 2s or 30s.
warm-hands.docked: Still a rotating spiral, so it risks reading as a spinner or cinnamon roll; the rim stain strokes go to mush at 120px, and animating inside a <use> shadow tree is untested in Safari.

the-glitch.signature_why: A five-pip left-to-right chaser that jumps from pip 5 back to pip 1 every 5s reads as a counter that resets, and the deliberate 3.05-3.55s slip means a load completing at ~3.2s freezes on a displaced band with an orange ghost: the exact broken mid-gesture exit I score down.
the-glitch.loved: The 1s drop with gravity easing and a ring on impact is genuinely of the drip ritual, and the code is tidy, dial-driven and honest that SVG children repaint.
the-glitch.docked: Designing a hitch into a loader puts a seam on purpose; hot orange pips and the ghost demand attention, and at 120px the side-view cup under a spout is close to generic coffee clip art.
